comments.author: EdibleFoothold
comments.body: Getting a bot rebuilt is one thing, but I'd be curious which changes actually improved the strategy versus just making the interface better. A clean comparison of the old and new versions would be interesting. I make my market direction decisions directly on Moon rather than relying on a bot and I'd want to see reliable forward results before trusting automation. Stability is probably just as important as profitability.
